svg.title: Filament cycle and take-up allowance
svg.desc: Insertion gives a short grip and NFC scan. A U1 load command starts fast feed and sensor seek. Unload retracts 1250 then feeds forward 300. The next fast feed uses 850. Unknown positions use only sensor seek.

g.text: Tested reference settings · Values are command parameters, not measured travel or speed.
Insert filament into an empty ACE slot.
ACE grips the filament and reads the tag. The long feed waits for the U1 Load command.
Confirmed insertion: 1150 at 200 → sensor seek at 50 → stop at the head sensor.
After a restart, an unknown position uses sensor seek only.
U1 unloads the tool → ACE retracts 1250 at 80 → ACE feeds forward 300 at 50.
The forward movement draws slack into the tube. It does not turn the spool roller independently.
Keep the filament in ACE. Select Load again.
850 at 200 → sensor seek at 50 → stop at the head sensor.
The material data stays in U1 until the ACE inlet becomes empty.
Next fast length = configured fast length − confirmed forward take-up
A failed movement does not create a new position record.
Use your own tube lengths. Enable forward take-up only after you check the available travel.
The package has no tension feedback. A fixed take-up length cannot detect when the spool becomes tight.
